No teaching moment

A store full of links, no path

Someone who finds you through a reel lands on a list of products and has to work out where to start on their own. When you're still in the fog, choosing is the hardest part, so most people choose nothing.

No qualifier

Your best fits look like everyone else

The survivors who are ready to invest in deeper support scroll past the same posts as everyone else. Nothing asks them to raise their hand, and there is no high-ticket programme to invite them into.

No list engine

Growth depends on today's post

Your free guide and quiz sit in the same link list as everything else. With no free class teaching and selling every day, new clients only appear when a post lands, and quiet weeks show up in your diary.

The survivors who trust your voice but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free "Out of the Fog" masterclass that sells your book and fills a new high-ticket coaching programme

You already have the book and the products. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that helps survivors see the patterns clearly, offers your book on the thank-you page, and invites the right people to apply for a new high-ticket private coaching programme we'd build with you.

Sound familiar?

You're not too sensitive. You were slowly erased.

  • You've come out of a relationship with a narcissist, or you're still in one, and you want your clarity back.
  • You replay conversations for hours, trying to work out what really happened.
  • You've started doubting your own memory, your judgement, even your own voice.
  • People around you don't see it, so you've stopped trying to explain.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

01

How the erasing happens

The quiet, step-by-step patterns that wear down your sense of self, and why they are so hard to spot while you're living them.

02

Why you doubt yourself

What years of being second-guessed can do to your confidence, and why it is not a flaw in you.

03

Naming the pattern

A simple way to write down what is happening so you can trust what you see again.

04

Your first boundary

One small, safe boundary to practise this week, and how to hold it when the pushback comes.

05

Your next step

How Lisa's book, her 8-week program and private coaching fit together, so you can choose the support that fits you.

Script 1: Reel, 30 to 45 seconds
Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"It didn't start with shouting"

Hook
"Narcissistic abuse almost never starts with shouting. Here's what it often starts with instead." (to camera, close framing, calm tone)
Body
"A comment about your friends. A story that doesn't quite match what you remember. An apology that somehow turns into your fault. On their own they look small. Together they slowly erase a person. I wrote a whole book about it, because I lived it." (on-screen text for each example)
CTA
"I'm teaching how the pattern works, and the first steps out of the fog, in a free 60-minute class. Tap Sign up to save a seat."
Script 2: Reel, 30 seconds
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Write it down"

Hook
"The simplest thing I teach survivors takes a pen and two minutes." (Lisa holds up a notebook)
Body
"When a conversation leaves you confused, write down what was said, word for word, the same day. Not how you felt. Just what happened. After a few weeks you're not relying on a memory someone keeps rewriting. You can see the pattern on the page." (captions on screen)
CTA
"In my free masterclass I'll walk through the full Pattern Spotting worksheet. Link below."
Script 3: Reel, 45 seconds
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where do I start?"

Hook
"People message me every week asking where to start. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"There's my book, How They Erase You. There's my 8-week program and private coaching. If you're new, don't pick yet. Come to my free class first. You'll understand the pattern, get some clarity back, and know which next step fits you."
CTA
"It's called Out of the Fog, it's free, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
